about: Lab 5 and 6 question set. `ref_sql` is the reviewed answer. `trap` names the failure class a model is expected to hit WITHOUT the business definitions. `compare` is `all` (whole result set) or `first_column` (for 'which' questions, where extra columns are fine). Numbers must match to within 0.01 (rounding only).

questions.question: How many orders were placed in May 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-05-01' AND '2024-05-31'

questions.question: How many distinct customers placed an order in April 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-04-30'

questions.question: How many active customers did we have as of 2024-01-15?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.order_date BETWEEN date('2024-01-15', '-90 day') AND '2024-01-15'

questions.question: What was total revenue in January 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_value) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31'

questions.question: What was the average value of delivered orders in June 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT AVG(o.order_value) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-06-01' AND '2024-06-30'

questions.question: What was the total lifetime value of all customers in the June 2024 snapshot?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT SUM(lifetime_value) FROM daily_customer_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM daily_customer_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date LIKE '2024-06%')

questions.question: How many refund claims were approved in March 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_refund_claim WHERE status = 'Approved' AND claim_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31'

questions.question: How many orders had at least one refund claim in March 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM fact_refund_claim WHERE claim_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31'

questions.question: Which city had the highest revenue in Q2 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(o.order_value) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was the average delivery time in minutes for delivered orders in July 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT AVG(o.delivery_minutes) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-07-31'

questions.question: How many restaurants serve Biryani cuisine?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_restaurant WHERE cuisine = 'Biryani'

questions.question: How many refund claims did customer 57 make in March 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_refund_claim WHERE customer_id = 57 AND claim_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31'

questions.question: Which customer made the most refund claims in 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT f.customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM fact_refund_claim f JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND f.claim_date LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY f.customer_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was the total order value lost to cancelled orders in August 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_value) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.status = 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-08-31'

questions.question: What was delivered revenue by region in Q3 2024?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.order_value) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY c.region

questions.question: How many orders did we get last month?
questions.ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_v2 o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_internal = 0 AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-11-01' AND '2024-11-30'
